questions.question: Describe how rock music of the 1960s and 1970s are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.

points.text: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use rock music of the 1960s and 1970s. Explain the effect in each case.

points.text: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how rock music of the 1960s and 1970s are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use rock music of the 1960s and 1970s in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.

points.text: A practical application showing understanding of how rock music of the 1960s and 1970s can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: name specific guitar techniques (palm mute, hammer-on, slide); identify drum kit components and patterns; explain the role of studio production; analyse texture and structure; use precise AQA vocabulary throughout.
